bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears' defense turned in a dominant performance in their 27-7 Monday Night Football win over the Philadelphia Eagles, with coordinator Dennis Allen calling it "a heck of a game" as the unit generated three takeaways and shut out the Eagles in three of four quarters . With Caleb Williams still sidelined by a hamstring injury, Bears coach Ben Johnson said "the direction has already been made" regarding the Week 4 starting quarterback against the Jets, though it remains unclear whether it will be Case Keenum or Tyson Bagent .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions made roster moves ahead of their Week 4 showdown with the Carolina Panthers, signing linebacker Amen Ogbongbemiga to the active roster from the practice squad while re-signing wideout Lawrence Keys to the practice squad . Meanwhile, the team's secondary situation remains a storyline as Detroit's secondary has been hit hard by injuries, leaving Dan Campbell with serious concerns on defense , even as the Lions prepare to face an injury-ravaged Carolina Panthers squad on Sunday night.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers continued their offensive line overhaul by signing veteran guard Kevin Zeitler, a Wisconsin native and former All-American, after he recovered from an offseason quad injury , giving Green Bay a new-look interior line that could debut as soon as this Sunday against Tampa Bay. The team is looking to bounce back after falling to a 1-2 start, their first such start since 2014, following a home loss to the Falcons , though star pass rusher Micah Parsons remains sidelined since he will be without for at least another week as he continues recovering from his ACL injury .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings bolstered their roster this week by signing running back Devin Neal, along with Audric Estime, Johnny Hekker and others, to the practice squad as they look to address depth issues at running back heading into Week 4 against Miami, even as the Minnesota Vikings have managed to grind their way to a 3-0 start, even though injuries continue to pile up across the board . Special teamer Myles Price was named NFC Special Teams Player of the Week for Week 3 , while the team also continues to monitor the health of tight end Josh Oliver after a torn biceps and receiver Justin Jefferson, who appears to have avoided a serious injury and could play Sunday.
